vulnerability_analysis: The contract owner can abuse their privileges by setting taxFee and liquidityFee to sum to 100%, causing any token transfer to be almost entirely taken as fees. These fees accumulate in the contract, and the owner can later extract them by excluding themselves from fees and transferring the contract's balance, or through swapAndLiquify mechanisms.
attack_strategy: 1. Impersonate the owner to set both fees to 50% each (total 100%). 2. Create a victim with tokens. 3. Have victim transfer tokens - most will go to contract as fees. 4. As owner, exclude yourself from fees. 5. Transfer contract's accumulated tokens to owner.
step_by_step_plan: 1. Use vm.prank to impersonate owner. 2. Call setTaxFeePercent(50) and setLiquidityFeePercent(50). 3. Create a victim address and give them tokens via deal(). 4. Have victim transfer tokens to another address (fees will be taken). 5. As owner, exclude yourself from fees with excludeFromFee(). 6. Transfer contract's token balance to owner.
